settlement: Conjunction of independently measured binary must-haves

native_integrity.source: instruction.md: preserve supplied business inputs, worksheet structure and offline calculation without macros or external links
native_integrity.predicate: The original nine sheets remain, no macros or external links exist, and native baseline business-input values match the material.

four_method_bridge.source: instruction.md: build four methods and link reporting-period depreciation, accumulated depreciation and carrying amounts
four_method_bridge.predicate: The supplied representative assets for all four methods have correct monthly schedules and YTD/cumulative/net/annual amounts at baseline and January.

period_ownership.source: instruction.md: transfers effective in recorded month; expenses follow occurrence month and balances follow reporting cutoff
period_ownership.predicate: A recorded April transfer correctly changes the affected departmental monthly expenses, historical dashboard flow and cutoff financial stocks.

year_department_bridge.source: instruction.md: reporting-period balances and departmental cutoff ownership; workbook supports report-year changes and service lives to 40 years
year_department_bridge.predicate: After the report year crosses service year twenty, the public dashboard cost, accumulated depreciation and net value for the supplied representative straight-line asset's configured department remain correctly linked.

safe_workload_opening.source: instruction.md and workbook opening conventions: keyed workload openings and clearly identified invalid inputs
safe_workload_opening.predicate: An opening above depreciable basis is visibly identified, while an opening just below the basis produces the correct remaining-quota monthly and balance results.

global_summary_correct.source: instruction.md: reporting-period balances, category and global reconciliation
global_summary_correct.predicate: All required category/global summaries and reconciliation outputs are correct across the measured periods.

all_required_diagnostics.source: instruction.md: identify invalid asset, master-data, workload and transfer inputs
all_required_diagnostics.predicate: Every declared invalid-input family is visibly diagnosed.

configured_capacity_maintenance.source: instruction.md: maintain the workbook within configured asset and dictionary capacity
configured_capacity_maintenance.predicate: Routine maintenance scenarios remain correct within configured capacity.
